Most places teach design and code as two separate subjects. Projection mapping is where that falls apart — the visual is the code, and the code is the visual. That is the whole point of this Lab.
You will write p5.js in your browser, and by the end of the night your work goes up on a real surface through a real projector. Everyone starts from the same template. No two results look the same.
You leave with a folder on your own machine, holding a sketch you changed yourself, that you can open again tomorrow without us in the room.
